sql: SELECT count(*) FROM maintenance_tasks WHERE state='pending' AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT p.provider_run_id) FROM maintenance_task_items m JOIN attempts a ON a.item_id=m.item_id JOIN provider_runs p ON p.provider_run_id=a.provider_run_id WHERE m.task_id=maintenance_tasks.task_id)>=1 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM maintenance_provider_outputs o WHERE o.task_id=maintenance_tasks.task_id AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attempts a WHERE a.item_id=o.item_id AND a.outcome IN('failed','dead_letter')))=0
query_plan: SEARCH maintenance_tasks USING COVERING INDEX maintenance_tasks_ready (state=?)
SEARCH p USING COVERING INDEX sqlite_autoindex_provider_runs_1 (provider_run_id=?)
SEARCH a USING COVERING INDEX attempts_item (item_id=? AND outcome=?)
